distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) document Heilongjiang. Smith et al. (2020) confirms Heilongjiang and additionally records Shaanxi. The current synthesis retains both supported provinces.

host_note: The current host summary retains identified hosts from the reviewed historical Chinese sources. Smith et al. (2020) describes the species broadly as polyphagous on angiosperms and conifers; that broader statement is retained as context and does not create unspecified host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Anisandrus dispar (Fabricius, 1792).
